source_refs.note: Book p. 12: 1.5.3 table of the six inverse hyperbolic functions (formula, domain, range)

blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne hyperbolic functions dekhe. Har achhe function ki tarah inhein bhi "ulta chalaya" ja sakta hai, yani value di ho to \(x\) wapas dhoonda ja sakta hai. Yahi inverse function hai. Is page par kitab sirf ek table deti hai jis mein chhe inverse hyperbolic functions ke formulas, domains aur ranges hain. In formulas mein se do ko hum agle page (1.5.4) par khud derive karenge, aur baqi chaar Exercise 1.2 ke Question 8 mein.
Kitab ke mutabiq tamam inverse hyperbolic functions ke formulas, domains aur ranges yeh hain (sirf \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1}\) ki range hum ne sahi kar ke likhi hai, neeche box dekhiye):

blocks.caption: The six inverse hyperbolic functions (sech⁻¹ range corrected)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} x\) ki range \((0, \infty[\) chhapti hai, yani mile jule brackets ke saath aur 0 ko bahar rakh kar. Lekin
\[\operatorname{sech}^{-1} 1 = \ln\left(\dfrac{1 + 0}{1}\right) = \ln 1 = 0\]
to 0 is function ki ek value hai. Sahi range \([0, \infty)\) (yani \([0, \infty[\)) hai, jo \(\operatorname{sech} x\) ke restricted domain ke barabar hai, bilkul \(\cosh^{-1} x\) ki tarah.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har formula mein \(\ln\) kyun hai? Hyperbolic functions \(e^{x}\) se bane hain. \(e^{x}\) ko "khatam" (undo) karne ke liye us ka inverse chahiye, aur woh \(\ln x\) hai (section 1.6). Bilkul aise jaise taala \(e^{x}\) ho to chaabi \(\ln\) hai.
Tareeqa hamesha ek hi hai, ise yaad kar lijiye:
1. \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) rakho, to \(x = f(y)\).
2. \(f(y)\) ko \(e^{y}\) ki shakal mein likho.
3. \(e^{y}\) ke liye equation hal karo (aksar quadratic banti hai).
4. Na-mumkin root (jaise negative \(e^{y}\)) chhor do aur \(\ln\) le lo.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Domain aur range ke columns kaise samjhein: inverse function in dono ko aapas mein badal deta hai. Misaal: \(\tanh x\) ki range \((-1, 1)\) hai, to \(\tanh^{-1} x\) ka domain \((-1, 1)\) hai; \(\tanh x\) ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\) hai, to \(\tanh^{-1} x\) ki range \(\mathbb{R}\) hai.
\(\cosh x\) aur \(\operatorname{sech} x\) even functions hain, \(\mathbb{R}\) par one-to-one nahin, is liye in ke liye sirf \(x \ge 0\) istemal karte hain. Isi wajah se \(\cosh^{-1} x\) aur \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} x\) sirf \(\ge 0\) values dete hain.
Domain hi formula ko ma'ni-khez (meaningful) rakhta hai: \(\ln\) sirf positive number ka hota hai. \(\tanh^{-1}\) mein \(\frac{1+x}{1-x} > 0\) bilkul tab hai jab \(-1 < x < 1\); \(\coth^{-1}\) mein \(\frac{x+1}{x-1} > 0\) bilkul tab hai jab \(|x| > 1\).

Ek aur chhoti si baat jo table mein chhupi hai: \(\operatorname{csch}^{-1} x\) ka formula dekhiye, \(\ln\left(\frac{1}{x} + \sqrt{\frac{1}{x^{2}}+1}\right)\). Yeh bilkul \(\sinh^{-1}\) wala formula hai, bas \(x\) ki jagah \(\frac{1}{x}\) rakha gaya hai. Wajah: \(\operatorname{csch} = \frac{1}{\sinh}\), to \(\operatorname{csch}^{-1} x = \sinh^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\). Isi tarah \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} x = \cosh^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\) aur \(\coth^{-1} x = \tanh^{-1}\frac{1}{x}\). Yaad rakhne ka yeh shortcut bohat kaam aata hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Aasan numbers se fori check:
\(\sinh^{-1} 0 = \ln(0 + 1) = 0\), kyun ke \(\sinh 0 = 0\).
\(\cosh^{-1} 1 = \ln(1 + 0) = 0\), kyun ke \(\cosh 0 = 1\).
\(\tanh^{-1} 0 = \frac{1}{2}\ln 1 = 0\), kyun ke \(\tanh 0 = 0\).
Agar koi formula is check mein fail ho to samajh lijiye ke copy karte waqt ghalti hui hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\cosh^{-1} 0.5\) kitna hoga? Socha? Formula mein \(\sqrt{0.25 - 1} = \sqrt{-0.75}\) aata hai jo real nahin. Wajah: \(\cosh y\) kabhi 1 se kam nahin hota, to koi \(y\) aisa nahin jis ka \(\cosh\) 0.5 ho. Is liye \(\cosh^{-1}\) ka domain \([1, \infty)\) hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari taraf se misaal hai.) \(\tanh^{-1}\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)\) nikaaliye:
\(\frac{1}{2}\ln\left(\frac{1 + 3/5}{1 - 3/5}\right) = \frac{1}{2}\ln\left(\frac{8/5}{2/5}\right) = \frac{1}{2}\ln 4 = \ln 2\).
Ab ulta check: page 1.5.1 par hum ne dekha tha ke \(\tanh(\ln 2) = \frac{3}{5}\). Bilkul mil gaya! Inverse ne value se \(x\) wapas de diya.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\sinh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2}+1}\right)\), har real \(x\) ke liye.
2. \(\cosh^{-1} x = \ln\left(x + \sqrt{x^{2}-1}\right)\), \(x \ge 1\) ke liye, values \(\ge 0\).
3. \(\tanh^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{1+x}{1-x}\) (\(|x| < 1\)); \(\coth^{-1} x = \frac{1}{2}\ln\frac{x+1}{x-1}\) (\(|x| > 1\)).
4. \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} x\): domain \((0, 1]\), range \([0, \infty)\); \(\operatorname{csch}^{-1} x\): domain aur range \(\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}\).
5. Inverse ka domain = function ki range; inverse ki range = function ka (restricted) domain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\sinh^{-1} x\) ko \(\frac{1}{\sinh x}\) samajhna: woh to \(\operatorname{csch} x\) hai, bilkul alag function.
2. \(x < 1\) ke liye \(\cosh^{-1} x\) nikaalne ki koshish (jaise \(\cosh^{-1} 0.5\)): koi real jawab nahin.
3. \(\tanh^{-1}\) aur \(\coth^{-1}\) ki fractions ulat dena: \(\frac{1+x}{1-x}\) \(\tanh^{-1}\) ki hai (\(|x| < 1\)), aur \(\frac{x+1}{x-1}\) \(\coth^{-1}\) ki (\(|x| > 1\)).
4. \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} x\) ki range se 0 nikaal dena: \(\operatorname{sech}^{-1} 1 = 0\).
